preview.text: England won the toss and chose to bat first in the one-day match against Western Australia at the W.A.C.A. Ground. The usual first-innings score in the 3 recorded one-day matches at this venue is 249. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 26 degrees.

summary.text: England scored 251 all out with Ben Duckett making 59 off 66 balls as Brody Couch took 4 for 47, while Adil Rashid claimed 4 for 35 to help dismiss WA for 159 despite Corey Wasley scoring 41 off 34 balls. England won the match by 92 runs.
